finding: All three ground/safety refusal reasons the M3 design names (height_unresolved, obstructed, and the upstream 'ambiguous ground column' / pick_destination refusal from src/wow/navigation.ts) were observed live, each stopping movement while a manual lease was still active and before it expired on its own timer.
